info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Replace Ecommerce Cart Merge-v1-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Merge API enables businesses to efficiently merge shopping cart items from multiple sessions or users into a single, cohesive cart. It serves as a crucial resource for e-commerce platforms looking to enhance user experience by retaining cart data across devices or user accounts. This API is typically utilized by developers working on customer engagement platforms and shopping applications to simplify cart management. With this operation, users can ensure all their selected products are conveniently organized, streamlining the checkout process.

put.summary: Merge items from another cart into the current cart.
put.description: This endpoint allows users to merge items from a specified cart into their current shopping cart. This is particularly useful when managing items across multiple carts or sessions. Ensure that the target cart is specified correctly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to merge the contents of two shopping carts. It allows clients to combine items from a secondary cart into the primary cart, ensuring that items are not duplicated and that quantities are adjusted accordingly.

200.description: Request completed successfully; cart items merged.
